subject: Session topology + SCIM attribute mapping request for SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearriverhealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@clearriverhealth.com
Date: Sun, 24 Jun 2028 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Request: Session traces + SCIM attribute mapping for SOC2 intake

Hi Dylan,

As part of our SOC 2 readiness review for the Redwood integration, our security team needs a short package with artifacts that demonstrate how user/session context is propagated and how provisioning changes flow into Redwood. Specifically we need: 
- Session trace captures (token/session binding, session start/stop, IP and region, cookie/session affinity) for a 30-day sample window (we'd prefer 2028-05-25 — 2028-06-24).
- A SCIM attribute mapping CSV (including attribute names, source system, transform rules, and which role claims map to RBAC roles).
- 3 SAML assertion samples (login flow with a typical user, an admin user, and a service account), with identifying PII redacted.
- Current RBAC snapshot (role -> permissions list) and the process for role approval/owner assignment.

Can you deliver these artifacts to our secure intake SFTP (sftp://sftp.clearriver-compliance/upload) by 2028-07-06? If SFTP is a problem we can accept a signed Drive link. Also let us know if any of these require a narrower retention window or additional redaction guidance.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Security Compliance
ClearRiver Health

--
Elena Torres
ClearRiver Health
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearriverhealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 24 Jun 2028 15:30:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Session traces + SCIM attribute mapping for SOC2 intake

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you requested. Quick clarifying questions before we start exports: 

1) Retention/redaction: you mentioned redacting PII for the SAML assertions. Do you want us to redact full email addresses or pseudonymize (user-1234@example.com)? For session traces we can redact IPs to /24s if you prefer.
2) SCIM mapping scope: include just identity attributes (name, email, group, entitlements) or also custom attributes we send for tenant routing (tenant_id, org_tier)?

Plan: I'll coordinate delivery and upload artifacts to your SFTP. Attached is an internal checklist (iam-evidence-checklist.xlsx) and a short workback plan (initial_workback.md) so you can see the proposed delivery cadence.

Proposed timeline: collect -> redact -> package -> upload by 2028-07-03, leaving room for your review before the 07-06 deadline.

If SFTP is a blocker we'll put a signed, time-limited Drive folder. Please confirm the redaction preference and whether to include custom attributes.

Best,
Dylan
Business Development
Redwood Inference

Attachments: iam-evidence-checklist.xlsx (workbook), initial_workback.md (workback notes)
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 24 Jun 2028 16:05:18 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Request: Session traces + SCIM attribute mapping for SOC2 intake

Looping you both in — ClearRiver wants a session topology package and SCIM mapping. Key asks in Elena's message (session traces for 30 days, SCIM CSV, 3 SAML samples, RBAC snapshot).

I attached an internal_export_instructions.txt that details how to pull session logs from the serving runtime (we need to include: request id, token id (hashed), session_start, session_end, source_ip (redact as /24), region, model_id, route, user_agent, and any role claim present).

Action items: 
- Jordan: can you own the session export and redaction? Use the export instructions and target the 2028-05-25 -> 2028-06-24 window. Aim to produce a compressed archive and a short README describing how entries map to our internal fields.
- Hannah: please pull the RBAC snapshot and the SCIM attribute map (CSV). The SCIM CSV should include columns: attribute_name, source_system, transform_rule, mapped_role, example_value. Mark any custom tenant attributes in the notes column.

Timeline: target drafts by EOD 2028-06-25 so we can do an internal review and then upload to SFTP. We will need engineering to run the log export job; Jordan, please confirm the estimated runtime and whether we need a maintenance window.

Forwarded message (excerpt):
> "As part of our SOC 2 readiness review ... we need session trace captures (token/session binding...)"

Thanks — Dylan

Attachments: internal_export_instructions.txt
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai

- Service accounts: we will flag service_account events and include the service_account_id (hashed) and the associated role claim.

1) session-traces-20280601-20280624.tar.gz (gzipped JSONL + README)

3) saml-sample-assertions.txt (3 redacted samples)
4) rbac-snapshot-20280624.json (role -> permission map)

I'll coordinate with infra to kick off the export today and should have the tar.gz ready by late afternoon. If you want, I can drop a short manifest in the Drive folder that maps internal fieldnames to the CSV/JSON keys for the security reviewers.

Jordan
